It’s a matter of coincidence that two of India’s greatest leaders in the freedom movement — Mahatma Gandhi and Lal Bahadur Shastri — were born on the same date (October 2), though 35 years apart. But the annals of history suggest that one’s ideas and ideals influenced the other immensely. In 1915, Gandhi arrived in India after his successful exploits in South Africa, where he transformed from a promising, young lawyer to a leading civil rights campaigner over the course of two decades (1893-1914). At the time, his focus on non-violent methods garnered much public attention. Shastri, only 11 at the time, was quite taken by Gandhi’s 1916 speech at the Banaras Hindu University (BHU). items.text: Why Akhilesh replaces Mahant with a Muslim face as Uttarakhand SP chief
items.article: In a bid to consolidate Muslim vote base in neighbouring west UP, SP replaces Shubham Giri with Abdul Mateen Siddiqui at the helm of Uttarakhand unit, calls Giri's performance “not satisfactory”. Less than five months before the high-stakes Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, Samajwadi Party (SP) chief Akhilesh Yadav has appointed a Muslim leader, Abdul Mateen Siddiqui, as the new president of the party unit in neighbouring Uttarakhand, replacing a mahant, Shubham Giri, who was named its working president over eight months ago. Uttarakhand is also slated for the Assembly elections along with UP, among other states, in February 2027. Siddiqui, 66, who hails from Nainital district, has held various positions in the Uttarakhand SP, including as its general secretary and state in-charge. items.text: Work Email Missing on Your Mac? This Could Be Why
items.article: If your work email on your Mac isn't syncing today, it might well have to do with Microsoft's cut-off of Exchange Web Services (EWS). As of October 1, 2026, Microsoft began switching off EWS by default in Exchange Online. If you haven't heard of it before, EWS is the aging protocol that Apple's Mail and Calendar apps still use to sync Microsoft 365 work accounts. The cutoff has been signposted for a while. Microsoft stopped adding new features to EWS back in 2018, while in 2023 the company announced that it would start disabling the protocol in Exchange Online from October 2026. It's being described as a phased rollout, so some users may be impacted sooner than others. For those affected, system admins can still turn EWS back on, but only until April 1, 2027, when it shuts down for good. Apple says that it is "actively working with Microsoft" to move its Mac apps over to the newer Graph API in a macOS 27 update. That update has yet to arrive, but it surely won't be long before it does. In the meantime, Outlook for Mac works just fine, and iPhone and iPad users won't be affected because they use Exchange ActiveSync rather than EWS. Get weekly top MacRumors stories in your inbox.

Amazon is addressing the Kindle ’s biggest problem – though not entirely. The company has launched a host of new Kindle e-readers, re-designing them to make them smaller and lighter. It has updated its base Kindle with a new design, as well as new versions of its easier-to-read Kindle Paperwhite and a new Kindle Colorsoft that has a colour display.
